scope: Apply the PR #449 review findings to the Main coordinator extraction without changing gameplay, input semantics or request/restore/cancellation ownership.
fixes: The conditional-collection scaffold check moved from IConversationTurnPorts into ConversationTurnNodePorts.OfferExamination (covered by CharacterExaminationFlowSmokeCheck).
The wagon-clue route throws a named exception for a missing Seeker perception instead of passing null! on.
Main.ConversationTurns throws a named exception if used before _Ready completes.
CharacterModelGenerationFlowController logs an unexpected generation fault as a warning instead of discarding it.

Four new tests (invisible healer on continuation, continuation before a same-frame submission, both cancellation guards); the cancel fake refuses a non-cancellable turn; the unreachable generating-with-result test is replaced by the reachable case. Each new test fails when its guard is removed.
Doc corrections in the ports, coordinators, MainProcessOrder, the plan and this record.
corrections_to_closed_record: docs/superpowers/evidence/2026-10-18-phase3-main-coordinators.json stays as committed. Read its 'each port member forwards to one existing node member' as a thin forward to existing node members, and its 'ten same-frame dependencies' as ten tree-order pins: seven same-frame process dependencies and three nodes without a per-frame callback.
Only Main gets an explicit priority; re-prioritizing its children would reorder them against hundreds of default-priority siblings (program plan item 2 said 'each').
Main's -40 priority also makes the 11 audio proof hosts that instance Main.tscn process after Main; they observe audio driven at -50, and their launches pass.
Its native 'failure' entry predates the #448 quarantine commit daad72a3.

native.note: All three quarantined launches (#437, #439, #448) passed in this run.

verification.retry_flake: ALLRPCS_ORDINARY_MODEL_FAILURE_CHECK=retry, measured alongside origin/main b0e390f5: alone 0/30 vs 0/30, 16-core CPU load 0/5 vs 0/5, three concurrent streams 0/12 vs 0/12. Recorded on #448; main and branch behave alike.
verification.mutation: Removing the healer filter, swapping continuation and submission, or removing either CanCancel guard each fails exactly its new test.
verification.review: Five review agents (code, tests, silent failures, types, comments) on PR #449, then a self-review of the fix diff.

issues: #448 updated with the retry measurements; no new issue was needed.
